limitations: Ten-second descriptive sample, not sustained throughput or physical-accuracy validation.
Rates use received messages and distinct source headers; marker refreshes may repeat LiDAR headers.
Probe subscribes to full raw scans and labeled images and adds transport/deserialization load.
Class totals count repeated observations across messages, not unique tracked objects.
Point classes are inferred only from the configured orange/magenta RGB palette.
Strict camera-associated outputs may be empty even while native LiDAR and camera detections are present.
Camera calibration and timing remain provisional; model KITTI-to-Ouster accuracy is unvalidated.
